text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - Elevated 5xx + 504s for tenant \"cedarpoint\" in dedicated cluster ded-eu-central-2. Alert groups: gateway_errors_high, inference_5xx. Detected ~06:42 UTC. Auto-page oncall.

oncall-sam: acked. i'm on it. pinging infra and eng.

sre-maya: joining. quick question — is this single-tenant impact or multi-tenant shard?

support-eli: cedarpoint reporting customer-facing failures: uploads failing, API returns 5xx intermittently. ticket #INC-12892. They asked for ETA and mitigation.

eng-jo: looking at telemetry: cedarpoint error rate spike started ~06:40. GPU util of shards serving cedarpoint at 97-100%. KV cache eviction metric jumped at 06:39. Lots of `kv_cache: eviction_count` and `worker_conn_reset` logs.

infra-kim: i can see one tenant, marigold, launched a heavy fine-tuning style streaming job at 06:35 with massive batch sizes (avg 460). It's on the same shard pool. Looks like noisy neighbor.

oncall-sam: can we confirm per-shard tenant placement? jo, run the placement query please.

eng-jo: ran:
```
redwood debug placement --cluster ded-eu-central-2 --shard shard-12
```
Output shows marigold + cedarpoint on shard-12 and shard-13. marigold traffic coincides with error bursts.

infra-kim: i'm going to apply a temporary QoS cap on marigold and evict long-running streaming workers. Command:
```
rctl tenant qos-set --tenant marigold --cluster ded-eu-central-2 --max-rps 60 --priority low
rctl workers evict --cluster ded-eu-central-2 --tenant marigold --filter "streaming=true" --count 3
```
Applying now.

sre-maya: good. cedarpoint is latency-sensitive. can we also move cedarpoint to a different less-loaded shard or enable a fallback model?

oncall-sam: i'll rehome cedarpoint traffic to an adjacent shard pool with spare capacity and enable a quantized fallback model simultaneously.

eng-jo: commands issued:
```
redwood route migrate --tenant cedarpoint --from-shard shard-12 --to-shard shard-9 --cluster ded-eu-central-2 --drain 30s
redwood route update --tenant cedarpoint --fallback cedarpoint-lite-q4 --prefix-cache enable
```

support-eli: drafting customer note: "We've identified increased errors and timeouts caused by another tenant's high-throughput streaming workload. We've applied rate limits to the noisy tenant, moved your traffic off the impacted shard, and temporarily routed you to a lower-memory fallback to restore availability. Monitoring now." Send?

oncall-sam: send it, include that we'll follow up with postmortem and a timeline for capacity changes.

infra-kim: QoS cap applied, eviction succeeded. marigold RPS dropped from ~820 to ~58.

eng-jo: after migration + fallback: cedarpoint 5xx rate dropped from ~180/min to ~6/min within 90s. Some 504s still trickling but much improved. KV evictions down 80%.

customer-cedarpoint-ops-liam: (DM) thanks, seeing recovery in our staging region; production traffic looks back to normal for now.

sre-maya: i'll keep thread open for 45m monitoring and then handoff to infra for follow-up. open action items: 1) capacity review for cedarpoint (consider reserved nodes), 2) SLA discussion with marigold tenant re: large streaming jobs, 3) improve tenant placement heuristics to avoid co-locating heavy batch jobs with latency-sensitive tenants.

oncall-sam: logging artifacts to /incidents/OP-2026-55555/artifacts — uploaded trimmed logs and the placement dump. excerpt:
```
06:38:57 shard-12 worker-21 WARN kv_cache eviction_count=342
06:39:11 shard-12 transport error: connection reset by peer
06:39:45 shard-12 OOM attempting kv cache grow
```

sre-maya: thanks. eli, send the customer update and ask if cedarpint wants a dedicated reserved pool for future heavy loads. typo in ticket if needed.

support-eli: sent. customer replied: "Appreciate the fast response. We'll review batch sizes on our side and discuss reserved capacity." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, status -> mitigated (monitoring). Recorded as OP-2026-55555.

sre-maya: closing live page. i'll draft the postmortem, assign infra & churn to improve placement heuristics. good response all.

oncall-sam: handing off monitoring to maya. i'm available if anything flares in next 15m.

customer-cedarpoint-ops-liam: thanks everyone, will review postmortem when ready.
